summary.text: Vaughn Stewart is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 19 who has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Stewart advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Environment and Transportation Committee, according to Ballotpedia.
